title: Sarah's baby book, 1931–1935
excerpt: “July 14th — Mama Klara held Sarah still long enough for Mr. Andersen to try his new camera. The only picture we have of the two of them together.”

title: Klara's immigration record
excerpt: Kowalska, Klara — age 14, arrived Port of Baltimore aboard the SS Rhein, June 1912, bound for Green Bay, Wisconsin.

title: Letter from Klara to Sarah
excerpt: “The cherries came in early this year. Your father says the porch needs painting but I told him it can wait until you visit…”

title: Klara's pierogi recipe card
excerpt: “Flour, two eggs, sour cream — never water. Brown butter at the end, always more than you think.”

title: Telegram — Tom coming home
excerpt: ARRIVING GREEN BAY STATION DEC 21 STOP HOME FOR CHRISTMAS STOP LOVE TOM
